metadata.title: Global seamount census

sources.citation: Gao, Y., Guo, J., Ya, S., Yu, D., Liu, X. & Hwang, C. (2026) SDUST2026SM: A Global Seamount Catalog Based on Vertical Gradient of Gravity Anomaly and Bathymetric Data (v1.0). Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.23277209. Paper: Earth Syst. Sci. Data Discuss., doi:10.5194/essd-2026-860 (preprint, in review)

Gevorgian, J., Sandwell, D. T., Yu, Y., Kim, S.-S. & Wessel, P. (2023) Global distribution and morphology of small seamounts. Earth and Space Science 10, e2022EA002331, doi:10.1029/2022EA002331; data: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.7718512

Kim, S.-S. & Wessel, P. (2011) New global seamount census from altimetry-derived gravity data. Geophys. J. Int. 186, 615-631, doi:10.1111/j.1365-246X.2011.05076.x (KWSMTS v0.1; contained in SIO2023, ids KW-xxxxx)
sources.licence: as redistributed in the SIO2023 Zenodo record (CC BY 4.0)

metadata.attribution: Seamounts: SDUST2026SM (Gao et al. 2026) and SIO 2023 / Kim & Wessel 2011 (Gevorgian et al. 2023), CC BY 4.0; summits from GEBCO_2026
metadata.licence: CC BY 4.0 (catalogues); GEBCO_2026 summit depths and TID under the GEBCO terms (OGL v3)

columns.lon: catalogue centre longitude, degrees (SDUST: 1' cell centre; SIO: VGG maximum)
columns.height_m: catalogue height above the base, m (SDUST: from GEBCO_2025 foot-of-slope; SIO-only: VGG Gaussian model, 100 m steps, 600 = below 700, 2600 = 2,600 or more)
columns.base_depth_m: catalogue base depth, m, positive down
columns.summit_depth_m: GEBCO_2026 15" shallowest cell within the summit disc, m, positive down (negative = above sea level); null = no grid value
columns.tid: GEBCO_2026 TID of that summit cell (10-17 directly measured, 40 predicted from gravity, ...)
columns.src: 0 = SDUST2026SM, 1 = SIO2023 only (no SDUST seamount within 10 km)
columns.cat: matched SIO 2023 id within 10 km: KW-xxxxx = Kim & Wessel 2011 census, SIO-xxxxx = new in 2023; '' = none
columns.name: GEBCO gazetteer name (see docs/data-contract.md for the matching rule), '' = unnamed
